Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. APPLICATIONS: TO ANALYSE / MONITOR HYDROGEN CONTENT IN FLUE GASES COMING FRO M SUBMERGED ARC FURNACE, CLEAN THROUGH WET TYPE GAS CLEANING PLANT, OTHER GASES PRESEN T: CARBON MONOXIDE (50-60%) & CARBON DIOXIDE-(15-30%) EACH APPROX., OXYGEN-(0.5-1.5 %), PRES SURE AT SAMPLING POINT AROUND - 100 mmWC, TEMPERATURE OF SAMPLING GAS AROUND: 45 °C TO 50 °C, PANEL MOUNTING. N MONOXIDE & CARBON DIOXIDE-40% EACH APPROX., HYDROGEN-4%, APPLICATIONS: TO ANALYSE / MON ITOR OXYGEN CONTENT IN FLUE GASES COMING FROM SUBMERGED ARC FURNACE, CLEAN THROUGH WE T TYPE GAS CLEANING PLANT, PRESSURE AT SAMPLING POINT AROUND - 100 mmWC, TEMPERATURE OF S AMPLING GAS AROUND: 45 °C TO 50 °C, OVERALL ACCURACY : ±1%, PANEL MOUNTING. Qunatity: 1 EACH Sr No: 3 Material Description: CARBON MONOXIDE AND CARBON-DI-OXIDE COMBINED GAS ANALYZER, RANGE:– CO :0 to 100 %CO2: 0 to 100%, Resolution:- 0.01, Overall Accuracy:- +/- 1% FSD, PRINCIPLE OF OPERATION:-I nfrared, POWER SUPPLY:- 230 V, 50 Hz, APPLICATION:- In line Gas analysis of Submerged Arc Furnace (Ferr o alloys) flue gases cleaned through wet type gas cleaning plant. SAMPLE GAS:-Operating Range of Pressur e of sample gas at sampling point:– 0 to 500 mmWC, Temperature:- (+) 50 Deg. C. Max., Moisture content: - above 90%, Dust:- 50 mg/M3 Display:- LCD with backlit, CO & CO2 shall be displayed simultaniously. Out put of analyzer:- 4 – 20 mA DC, two wire, for each channel (for remote indication). Load resistance: 550 Oh m each.. The analyzer shall have zero span adjustment/ calibration facility accessible from front soft key p ad. Continuous supply of any other reference gas/air for normal working of the analyzer is not accepted. E nclosure of analyzer:Indoor duty. The analyzer shall be flush mounting type, ambient temperature: 50 Deg. C., Humidity: 95 % Max. , the other components of gases are O2 21 % Max. and Hydrogen – 8 % (Normal). Analysing process shall not have interference of the other gases present in the sample. Influence of Pressu re: Independent of pressure in the range of the permissible operating conditions. Quantity: 1 EACH ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: 1.The bidder may visit CFP, Chandrapur to study the site conditions and existing installation before submit ting the offer. Any claim arising due to lack of site knowledge shall not be entertained. 2.The offer shall be submitted in two separate parts: a)Technical Bid b)Commercial Bid 3.In case the bidder is not the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), a photocopy of a valid dealership/a uthorization certificate issued by the OEM shall be submitted along with the offer. 4.The proposed Oxygen (O2)Analyzer, Hydrogen Gas Analyzer and Combined Carbon Monoxide (CO) and C arbon Dioxide (CO2)In-line Gas Analyzer shall be compatible with the existing gas sampling system installed at CFP. The analyzer shall operate satisfactorily with a sample gas flow rate of 40–60 litres per ho ur. 5.The equipment shall be packed adequately to withstand normal handling, loading, unloading, and transp ortation conditions without any damage. 6.Installation of the analyzer shall be carried out by CFP personnel under the guidance of the supplier. Com missioning, calibration, performance testing, and successful demonstration of the analyzer shall be carried out by the supplier at CFP site. 7.The supplier shall provide complete technical documentation including operation manuals, maintenance manuals, calibration procedures, wiring diagrams, and troubleshooting guides along with the supply. 8.The supplier shall impart onsite training to CFP Instrumentation personnel covering operation, routine m aintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and safety aspects of the analyzer. 9.The analyzer shall be supplied with a minimum warranty of 12 months from the date of commissioning o r 18 months from the date of supply, whichever is earlier. 10.The supplier shall ensure availability of spare parts and technical support for a minimum period of five years from the date of supply. 11.The offered analyzers shall be suitable for continuous online monitoring of oxygen, Hydrogen, Carbon monoxide and Carbon dioxide content in SAF flue gases and shall be capable of interfacing with the existin g PLC/SCADA system through 4–20 mA output and/or Modbus communication. 12.The supplier shall furnish a list of major installations of similar analyzers supplied to Ferro Alloy, Steel, P

ower, Cement, Chemical, or other process industries during the last five years. SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITION: 1. Delivery Required-within 32 weeks of purchase order. 2. Spl.Del/Pkg/Insp Instructions: PACKING SHOULD WITHSTAND MODE OF TRANSPORTATION 3. The tenderer will be responsible for building awareness among their concerned employees about the ap plicable rules regarding environment. 4. All other terms & conditions as per SAIL P1. 5.
